shortdescription.en: Free software CUPS driver for the HP LaserJet Professional P1600dn series on macOS (Apple Silicon)

comments.en:
Native CUPS raster driver for the HP LaserJet Professional P1606dn, P1607dn, P1608dn and P1609dn on macOS 11 or later on Apple Silicon (arm64). It writes the printer's PJL/ZjStream job with JBIG-compressed pages (600 dpi and FastRes 1200), including automatic duplex, and comes with its own PPD, printer status from the printer's PJL replies, toner level, a printer utility, notifications and an AirPrint / IPP Everywhere server.

This driver runs on macOS only. On Linux, use the foo2zjs driver, which is available in the Ghostscript Printer Application.

Install it with Homebrew (brew install --cask berkbb/tap/p1600dn) or from source; it is built and tested on the Mac before it is installed.
